text:
Renee: Quick heads-up - over the last 3 hours a handful of webinar signups from APAC landed in HS with owner=unassigned. SDRs reported empty company/name fields.
Omar: Any change in the enrichment vendor or webhook retries? We flipped in retry policy last night.
Renee: Yes we reduced retries to speed create_time. But now if enrichment is slow, HS clears props and RR grabs the lead with blanks.
Cass: Can we gate RR on a simple flag `hs:enrichment_ok` and set a short debounce so we don't drop leads during quiet-hours processing?
Jules: Suggestion: 3-prong plan:
1) HubSpot workflow: set `enrichment_hold=true` at ingest, clear on success
2) Router: skip RR while `enrichment_hold` and auto-unhold after 30s
3) SF sync: block pushes until `enrichment_ok=true`
Renee: Pseudo-workflow:
```
set enrichment_hold_ts = now()
call enrichment (timeout 4s)
if success -> enrichment_ok=true; enrichment_hold_ts = null
else -> leave hold for 30s
```
Omar: I'll implement router skip behind feature-flag and log `rr.skip=hold` + region tag. Canary to APAC 3%.
Cass: I'll update the handoff SLA doc: "Do not outreach until enrichment_ok OR created > 30s". Also add SDR saved view `hs:enrichment_hold`.
handoff-bot: ALERT 3101234570 - router detected 9 leads with enrichment_hold > 10m. action=investigate
Jules: Metrics to watch: `marketing.handoff.unassigned_rate`, `sdr.manual_backfill_count`, and `enrichment.vendor.latency_p50/p95`. We'll monitor for 24h then decide ramp.
Renee: Action items: Omar deploys feature-flag (ETA 2h), Cass updates playbook + SDR view (ETA EOD), Jules adds metrics to dashboard (ETA 3h). I'll post rollback steps in #marketing-ops. Thanks all :rocket:
